# Booking.com messaging fixtures

Responses in the shape Booking.com documents for its Connectivity Messaging API
(https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/messaging-api/managing-conversations
and .../managing-messages, Accept-version 1.2). They are written from the
documentation, not captured from a live account; identifiers, names and text are
synthetic. Booking.com messaging connects with the owner's connectivity partner
account; Airbnb and Vrbo publish no messaging API outside their partner programs.
